chapterInfo.content:
34
Elihu kɔ so ara ka Hiob anim
1Na Elihu toaa so sɛ:
2Anyansafoɔ, montie me nsɛm,
na mo, animdefoɔ, monyɛ aso mma me.
3 # Hiob 12.11 Na aso na ɛsɔ nsɛm hwɛ,
na ano ka aduane hwɛ.
4Yɛbɛsɔ atemmuo ahwɛ afa,
na yɛahunu deɛ ɛyɛ yɛn ntam.
5 # Hiob 33.9; 27.2 Na Hiob aka sɛ: Metene,
nanso Onyankopɔn afa me bem kɔ.
6 # Hiob 9.15, 20; 6.4 Me bem mu ara na wɔbu me torofoɔ,
m’agyan kuro mu ayɛ den, nanso mmarato nni me mu.
7 # Hiob 15.16 Ɔbarima bɛn na ɔte sɛ Hiob
a ɔnom mmusubɔ sɛ nsuo,
8 # Dwom 1.1 na ɔhyɛne amumuyɛfoɔ ayɔnkofa mu,
na ɔne nnipa abɔnefoɔ ananteɛ?
9 # Hiob 9.22 Na ɔka sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mfasoɔ mma onipa
sɛ ɔne Onyankopɔn bɔ.
10Enti mo a mowɔ tire, montie me,
ɛmpare Onyankopɔn sɛ ɔbɛdi asɛmmɔne,
na Otumfoɔ bɛdi amumuyɛsɛm,
11 # Rom 2.6 na mmom, onipa nneyɛɛ so ka na ɔtua no,
na sɛdeɛ obi kwan teɛ no, saa na ɔma no to no.
12 # Hiob 19.6 Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn nni asɛmmɔne,
na Otumfoɔ nkyea atemmuo.
13Hwan na ɔde asase hyɛɛ ne nsa,
na hwan na ɔsiesiee wiase nyinaa?
14Sɛ ɔgye ne home fa
na ɔtwe ne honhom ne n’ahome ba ne nkyɛn a,
15 # Gye 3.19; Dwom 104.29 anka honam nyinaa bɛgyaa mu prɛko,
na onipa bɛsane akɔ dɔteɛ mu.
16Na sɛ wowɔ nhunumu a, tie yei,
yɛ aso ma me nsɛm.
17Deɛ ɔkyiri atɛntenenee bɛnya aman adi so anaa?
Anaasɛ wobɛbu ɔteneneeni tumfoɔ no fɔ?
18Deɛ ɔka kyerɛ ɔhene sɛ: Ohuhuni!
Ne mmapɔmma sɛ: Abɔnefoɔ!
19Deɛ ɔnhwɛ atitire anim,
na ɔmmu ɔdehyeɛ nsene mmɔborɔni;
ɛfiri sɛ ne nsa ano adwuma ne wɔn nyinaa.
20Mpofirim na wɔwuo,
na adasuo mu na aman hinhim na wɔsene korɔ,
na wɔpra aberempɔn kɔ, nso ɛnnam onipa nsa so.
21 # Hiob 31.4; Mmb 5.21 Na n’ani wɔ onipa akwan so,
na ɔhunu n’anammɔntutuo nyinaa.
22 # Dwom 139.11-12 Esum nni hɔ, na esum kabii nni hɔ,
na amumuyɛfoɔ de wɔn ho ahunta hɔ.
23Na ɛnhia sɛ ɔhwɛ onipa ma no kyɛ
ansa na wakɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, atemmuo mu.
24Ɔbubu aberempɔn a ɔnhwehwɛ wɔn asɛm mu,
na ɔde afoforɔ si wɔn ananmu.
25Ɛno nti ɔhwɛ wɔn nneyɛɛ,
na ɔbutu wɔn anadwo ma wɔdwerɛ wɔn.
26Ɔhwe wɔn sɛ abɔnefoɔ
ma nnipa nyinaa hunu.
27Ɛfiri sɛ wɔmane firii n’akyiri kɔe,
na wɔannwene n’akwan no biara ho,
28 # Eks 22.23 sɛ wɔbɛma mmɔborɔni sufrɛ aduru ne nkyɛn,
na wate amanehunufoɔ sufrɛ.
29Na sɛ ɔno na ɔma no dwo a, hwan na ɔbɛbu fɔ?
Na ɔde n’ani hunta a, hwan na ɔbɛhu no?
Ɔman mu so oo, ɔbaakofoɔ so oo, ɔyɛ no pɛ,
30na onipa kɔnkɔnsani anni hene,
na wɔansum ɔman fidie.
31Na obi bɛka akyerɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ:
Mahunu amane, merenyɛ amumuyɛ bio,
32 # Hiob 40.5 deɛ mennya menhunuiɛ, wo na kyerɛ me,
sɛ madi amumuyɛsɛm a, merenni bio?
33Na worepo ne nneyɛɛ yi, ɔnhyɛ wo ananmu sɛdeɛ wopɛ anaa?
Enti wo na ɛsɛ sɛ woyi, na ɛnyɛ me,
na deɛ wonim no, ka ɛ!
34Nnipa a wɔwɔ tire bɛka akyerɛ me,
na ɔbarima nyansafoɔ bɛtie ama me,
35 # Hiob 38.2 Hiob deɛ, ɛnyɛ nimdeɛ so na ɔkasa,
na ne nsɛm mu nni nhunumu.
36Sɛ anka wɔresɔ Hiob ahwɛ akɔsi awieeɛ ɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ ne mmuaeɛ te sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ mmuaeɛ.
37 # Hiob 34.5 Na ɔde mmusubɔ ka ne bɔne ho,
yɛn mu mpo ɔbɔ ne nsam,
na ɔma ne nsɛm a ɔne Onyankopɔn de di asie no dɔɔso.

Na Elihu toaa so sɛ:
Anyansafoɔ, montie me nsɛm,
na mo, animdefoɔ, monyɛ aso mma me.
Na aso na ɛsɔ nsɛm hwɛ,
na ano ka aduane hwɛ.
Yɛbɛsɔ atemmuo ahwɛ afa,
na yɛahunu deɛ ɛyɛ yɛn ntam.
Na Hiob aka sɛ: Metene,
nanso Onyankopɔn afa me bem kɔ.
Me bem mu ara na wɔbu me torofoɔ,
m’agyan kuro mu ayɛ den, nanso mmarato nni me mu.
Ɔbarima bɛn na ɔte sɛ Hiob

na ɔhyɛne amumuyɛfoɔ ayɔnkofa mu,

Na ɔka sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mfasoɔ mma onipa
sɛ ɔne Onyankopɔn bɔ.

Enti mo a mowɔ tire, montie me,
ɛmpare Onyankopɔn sɛ ɔbɛdi asɛmmɔne,
na Otumfoɔ bɛdi amumuyɛsɛm,
na mmom, onipa nneyɛɛ so ka na ɔtua no,
na sɛdeɛ obi kwan teɛ no, saa na ɔma no to no.
Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn nni asɛmmɔne,
na Otumfoɔ nkyea atemmuo.
Hwan na ɔde asase hyɛɛ ne nsa,
na hwan na ɔsiesiee wiase nyinaa?

na ɔtwe ne honhom ne n’ahome ba ne nkyɛn a,

Na sɛ wowɔ nhunumu a, tie yei,

Mpofirim na wɔwuo,
na adasuo mu na aman hinhim na wɔsene korɔ,
na wɔpra aberempɔn kɔ, nso ɛnnam onipa nsa so.

Na n’ani wɔ onipa akwan so,
na ɔhunu n’anammɔntutuo nyinaa.
Esum nni hɔ, na esum kabii nni hɔ,
na amumuyɛfoɔ de wɔn ho ahunta hɔ.
Na ɛnhia sɛ ɔhwɛ onipa ma no kyɛ
ansa na wakɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, atemmuo mu.
Ɔbubu aberempɔn a ɔnhwehwɛ wɔn asɛm mu,
na ɔde afoforɔ si wɔn ananmu.
Ɛno nti ɔhwɛ wɔn nneyɛɛ,
na ɔbutu wɔn anadwo ma wɔdwerɛ wɔn.
Ɔhwe wɔn sɛ abɔnefoɔ
ma nnipa nyinaa hunu.
Ɛfiri sɛ wɔmane firii n’akyiri kɔe,

na wate amanehunufoɔ sufrɛ.

Na obi bɛka akyerɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ:
Mahunu amane, merenyɛ amumuyɛ bio,
deɛ mennya menhunuiɛ, wo na kyerɛ me,
sɛ madi amumuyɛsɛm a, merenni bio?
Na worepo ne nneyɛɛ yi, ɔnhyɛ wo ananmu sɛdeɛ wopɛ anaa?

na deɛ wonim no, ka ɛ!
Nnipa a wɔwɔ tire bɛka akyerɛ me,
na ɔbarima nyansafoɔ bɛtie ama me,
Hiob deɛ, ɛnyɛ nimdeɛ so na ɔkasa,

Sɛ anka wɔresɔ Hiob ahwɛ akɔsi awieeɛ ɛ,

Na ɔde mmusubɔ ka ne bɔne ho,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
